issues.what: Akkadian Empire stays drawn as the whole Cliopatria -2200 shape (Upper Mesopotamia, Assyria, northern Syria, 731 cells beyond Akkad and Kish) from -2189 to -2154, although the dossier's own keyframe text and the page limit Dudu's kingdom to northern Babylonia around Akkad and Kish; the land only vanished in the -2154 dissolve

Snap at -2200: akkadian-empire_-2200 removes 497 cells of northern Syria and Cilicia (Aleppo, Ar Raqqah, Mersin) held by the -2220 peak shape; no dated loss on the page (only 'decline of imperial ambitions' under Shar-kali-sharri, accession c. 2217/2205/2165); the date -2200 is Cliopatria's shape start

Shakkanakku state of Mari has no dossier: mari ends -2290 (destroyed by Sargon), Mari 'gained its independence' in Shar-kali-sharri's reign and the Shakkanakku dynasty (first Ididish c. 2266) ruled to the Lim dynasty c. 1830; nothing is drawn on the middle Euphrates from -2290

Gutian snap at -2189 (326 cells in Al-Muthannia, An-Najaf, Al-Basrah) came from the gazetteer region Sumer (543 cells, six whole admin-1s, desert west of the Euphrates included); after the Akkad patch the snap is explained by gutian-dynasty/ledger/1, the drawn shape is the same. The Sumer region is the dossiers' choice (also used for Uruk and Ur III) and the pages give no outline

Lower Egypt -2160..-2062 draws a detached 60 km disc at Abydos (38 cells, mostly desert in Al Wadi at Jadid and Al Bahr al Ahmar) about 45 km south of the Siut strip; the page says Abydos was northern land until Intef III and that Siut was the south of the Heracleopolitan kingdom, but gives no territory between
Elam keyframe -2200 drops Ilam (70 cells, the conjectured Awan highland) and 45 Khuzestan cells held by the -2700 keyframe; the Awan page only conjectures Awan in Ilam and/or Fars
Size-rule conflicts (elam/gutian 6, lower/upper-egypt 3, lagash/uruk 3, elam/uruk 2 cell-years) are all under 10 cells in Al-Basrah, Al Wadi at Jadid, Qina and Dhi-Qar; the smaller state won

dossier_requests.what: New dossier for the Shakkanakku state of Mari (Second Kingdom / third Mari city): start c. 2266 BC (Ididish, appointed under Akkad; independent in Shar-kali-sharri's reign), nominally under Ur hegemony in the Ur III period, end c. 1830 BC when the Amorite Lim dynasty took the seat (the Lim dynasty dossier starts -1830). Land: Mari and the middle Euphrates as in the mari dossier's successor note (Euphrates within 40 km, Dayr Az Zawr and Al-Anbar).
dossier_requests.why: The mari dossier ends -2290 and itself says the Shakkanakku state needs its own dossier; the window -2200..-2101 draws nothing on the middle Euphrates although the page has an independent Mari throughout.
